identity.title: IEP review (US federal, IDEA Part B) - customer and professional profile draft
identity.description: Draft 0.5.1. Checks, chains, calculations, question ids, and report section ids match 0.5.0. Customer and professional objectives live on the personas. A review-required condition stays a review. Not published.

definitions.label: Imported legacy guidance
definitions.text: This pack says what to check, what to compute, what to ask for and the order of the answer. It never supplies facts about the case.

definitions.label: Imported legacy guidance
definitions.text: Every check gets one verdict from cited facts only: SHOWN, PARTLY SHOWN, NOT SHOWN, CONFLICT, NOT APPLICABLE.

definitions.label: Imported legacy guidance
definitions.text: NOT SHOWN means "these documents don't show it", not "it didn't happen". It becomes a question and, where a document would settle it, a document request.

definitions.label: Imported legacy guidance
definitions.text: No legal conclusions in either report. Never "violation", "illegal", "the school must". The authority column is shown in the professional report only, as "see 34 CFR ...".

definitions.label: Imported legacy guidance
definitions.text: "Days" in the federal rules are calendar days unless the rule says school or business days (34 CFR 300.11(a)).

definitions.label: Imported legacy guidance
definitions.text: The study date is given with the input. Judge whether the plan is current against that date (check T0), and say so first in both reports when it is not.

definitions.label: The plan is current: the study date falls within the IEP's dates, and no goal date or annual review date has passed
definitions.question: This plan's dates have passed. Is there a newer IEP, or a review meeting I haven't seen?
definitions.evidenceDescription: IEP start and end dates, goal dates, meeting date, compared with the study date (C10)

definitions.label: Parent gave informed consent before the evaluation began
definitions.question: When did I give consent to evaluate, and can I have a copy?
definitions.evidenceDescription: Signed consent date earlier than first test date

definitions.label: Evaluation finished within 60 days of the school receiving consent, or within the state's own timeframe
definitions.question: How many days did the evaluation take, and what is our state's limit?
definitions.evidenceDescription: Consent date and evaluation completion date (C1); any recorded exception (parent did not produce child; child changed district)

definitions.label: IEP meeting held within 30 days of deciding the child needs special education
definitions.evidenceDescription: Eligibility date and IEP meeting date (C2)

definitions.label: Parent was told about the meeting early enough to attend, with its purpose, time, place and who would be there
definitions.evidenceDescription: Meeting notice; parent listed as attending

definitions.label: Written notice, a reasonable time before each proposal or refusal (evaluate, identify, place), describing the action and the reasons
definitions.question: Can I have the prior written notice for each decision?
definitions.evidenceDescription: Prior written notice document(s)

definitions.label: Parent was given the procedural safeguards notice at referral or request for evaluation
definitions.question: Can I have a copy of my procedural safeguards?
definitions.evidenceDescription: Receipt, checkbox or statement

definitions.label: Consent for first-time services is separate; consent to evaluate does not count as consent for services
definitions.question: What exactly am I consenting to when I sign?
definitions.evidenceDescription: Consent for initial provision of services

definitions.label: Services are made available as soon as possible after the IEP is written
definitions.question: Why do services start on that date?
definitions.evidenceDescription: Service start dates (C3)

definitions.label: Parent received a copy of the IEP at no cost
definitions.evidenceDescription: Statement or receipt

definitions.label: Testing used a variety of tools, did not rest on a single measure, drew on several sources including parent input, and covered every area related to the suspected disability
definitions.question: Which concerns from the referral were not tested, and why?
definitions.evidenceDescription: Referral concerns vs areas assessed; list of measures

definitions.label: Eligibility was decided by a group of qualified professionals and the parent; category and educational need are both stated
definitions.evidenceDescription: Eligibility determination

definitions.label: Team considered whether lack of appropriate instruction in reading or math, or limited English, is the deciding factor
definitions.question: How did the team rule out other causes?
definitions.evidenceDescription: Eligibility form section or statement

definitions.label: Learning disability only: the team found the results are not mainly due to vision, hearing or motor disability, intellectual disability, emotional disturbance, cultural factors, environmental or economic disadvantage, or limited English
definitions.question: How did the team rule out other causes?
definitions.evidenceDescription: Exclusionary-factors section completed

definitions.label: Learning disability only: data shows appropriate instruction by qualified staff before or during referral, and repeated progress checks that were given to the parents
definitions.question: Can I see the intervention data collected before the referral? Was it sent to me at the time?
definitions.evidenceDescription: Intervention / progress-monitoring data; evidence parents received it

definitions.label: Learning disability only: the child was observed in the learning environment, including the regular classroom
definitions.question: Who observed my child in class, and when?
definitions.evidenceDescription: Observation report with date, observer and setting; behaviour noted in the eligibility report

definitions.label: Learning disability only: each team member certified in writing whether the report reflects their conclusion; any dissent is attached
definitions.evidenceDescription: Signatures / certification

definitions.label: Parent received the evaluation report and the eligibility documentation at no cost
definitions.question: Can I have copies of every evaluation report?
definitions.evidenceDescription: Statement or receipt

definitions.label: Learning disability only, where a response-to-intervention process was used: the report records the strategies and data, and that parents were told about the data to be collected, strategies to speed learning, and their right to request an evaluation
definitions.evidenceDescription: Eligibility report section

definitions.label: Present levels of academic and functional performance say how the disability affects progress in the general curriculum
definitions.evidenceDescription: Present-levels statement

definitions.label: Every number in present levels matches the evaluation it came from
definitions.question: The IEP and the evaluation give different numbers for the same test. Which is right?
definitions.evidenceDescription: Same measure, same value, same date (C6)

definitions.label: Child's strengths and the parent's concerns are recorded
definitions.question: Where are my concerns written down?
definitions.evidenceDescription: Strengths; parent input section not blank

definitions.label: Each need found in the evaluations has a measurable annual goal (academic or functional)
definitions.question: Which goal covers this need?
definitions.evidenceDescription: Chain 2

definitions.label: Each goal has a baseline, a target, how it is measured, a mastery rule and a date
definitions.question: How will we know this goal is met?
definitions.evidenceDescription: Goal text

definitions.label: The target is ambitious for the time allowed
definitions.question: How was this target chosen? Will it narrow the gap with classmates?
definitions.evidenceDescription: Gain per week (C4) and gap to typical (C8, C9) when the measure is WCPM

definitions.label: How progress is measured and when periodic reports go to parents
definitions.question: When will I get progress reports, and what will they show?
definitions.evidenceDescription: Progress-reporting section

definitions.label: Every service lists start date, frequency, location and duration
definitions.evidenceDescription: Service grid

definitions.label: Each goal has a service that delivers it
definitions.question: Who works on this goal, and for how many minutes?
definitions.evidenceDescription: Chain 2

definitions.label: Each evaluation recommendation is in the IEP, or the record says why not
definitions.question: The evaluation made a recommendation that I can't find in the plan. Where is it?
definitions.evidenceDescription: Chain 3; prior written notice for refusals

definitions.label: The instruction or program is named, and rests on peer-reviewed research where practicable; supports or training for staff are listed if needed
definitions.question: What program or method will be used, and what is it based on?
definitions.evidenceDescription: Service description

definitions.label: Time away from classmates without disabilities is stated and explained
definitions.question: Why is this done outside the classroom?
definitions.evidenceDescription: Setting, minutes (C5), explanation

definitions.label: Classroom accommodations are listed, and accommodations for state and district tests
definitions.evidenceDescription: Accommodations section

definitions.label: Special factors were each answered (behaviour, limited English, vision, communication, assistive technology)
definitions.evidenceDescription: Checkboxes completed

definitions.label: Extended school year was considered
definitions.evidenceDescription: ESY section completed

definitions.label: Transition goals and services, if the IEP will be in effect when the child turns 16 (or younger if the team decides)
definitions.evidenceDescription: Transition section

definitions.label: Required people attended or were excused in writing with the parent's agreement: parent, regular education teacher, special education teacher, district representative, someone who can explain what the test results mean for teaching
definitions.question: Who explained the test results at the meeting?
definitions.evidenceDescription: Attendance / signature page; excusal forms

definitions.label: No blank fields, unticked required boxes, empty "Other (specify)", or dates and names that disagree
definitions.question: Part of the form is blank. What should it say?
definitions.evidenceDescription: Form fields

definitions.label: If an alternate assessment, why the child cannot take the regular one and why the alternate is appropriate.
definitions.evidenceDescription: Recorded fields: entity:assessment-participation (assessmentName, participationType, alternateJustification). REVIEW_REQUIRED. Not an executable predicate and not a compliance verdict.

definitions.label: Between annual reviews, parent and agency may agree in writing to amend without a meeting; team is informed. Changes may be made by amendment; parent may request a revised copy with amendments incorporated.
definitions.evidenceDescription: Recorded fields: entity:amendment (amendmentDate, method, writtenAgreement, changesAsWritten, teamInformed, revisedCopyProvided). Documents that name this check: document:iep-amendment. check:AM1 and check:AM2 both draw on 34 CFR 300.324(a)(4). The ontology does not state a further split, so none was written. REVIEW_REQUIRED. Not an executable predicate and not a compliance verdict.

definitions.label: Between annual reviews, parent and agency may agree in writing to amend without a meeting; team is informed.
definitions.evidenceDescription: Recorded fields: entity:amendment (amendmentDate, method, writtenAgreement, changesAsWritten, teamInformed, revisedCopyProvided). Documents that name this check: document:prior-iep, document:iep-amendment. check:AM1 and check:AM2 both draw on 34 CFR 300.324(a)(4). The ontology does not state a further split, so none was written. REVIEW_REQUIRED. Not an executable predicate and not a compliance verdict.

definitions.label: Changes may be made by amendment; parent may request a revised copy with amendments incorporated.
definitions.evidenceDescription: Recorded fields: entity:amendment (amendmentDate, method, writtenAgreement, changesAsWritten, teamInformed, revisedCopyProvided). Documents that name this check: document:iep-amendment. REVIEW_REQUIRED. Not an executable predicate and not a compliance verdict.

definitions.label: The team considered whether the child needs assistive technology devices and services. Consideration does not dictate the outcome.
definitions.evidenceDescription: Recorded fields: entity:assistive-technology (itemText, considered, provided); entity:special-factor (factor, consideredStatement, needIdentified). Documents that name this check: document:at-evaluation. The shared special-factor authority requires consideration. It does not dictate the outcome. FBA and BIP methodology stays deferred. REVIEW_REQUIRED. Not an executable predicate and not a compliance verdict.

definitions.label: The team considered behavior as a special factor, including positive behavioral interventions and supports. Consideration does not dictate the outcome.
definitions.evidenceDescription: Recorded fields: entity:special-factor (factor, consideredStatement, needIdentified); entity:behavior-assessment (completionDate, targetBehavior, hypothesizedFunction); entity:behavior-plan (planDate, targetBehavior, strategiesText). Documents that name this check: document:fba-report, document:bip. The shared special-factor authority requires consideration. It does not dictate the outcome. FBA and BIP methodology stays deferred. REVIEW_REQUIRED. Not an executable predicate and not a compliance verdict.

definitions.label: As part of an initial evaluation (if appropriate) and any reevaluation, the team reviews existing data, including parent-provided evaluations and observations.
definitions.evidenceDescription: Recorded fields: entity:evaluation (evaluationType, startDate, completionDate, reviewOfExistingDataDate, noAdditionalDataDecision, exceptionAsWritten). Documents that name this check: document:review-of-existing-data. REVIEW_REQUIRED. Not an executable predicate and not a compliance verdict.

definitions.label: If the child has not made adequate progress after an appropriate period, or whenever referred, the agency promptly requests parental consent to evaluate.
definitions.evidenceDescription: Recorded fields: entity:referral (requestDate, requestedBy, requestType, suspectedAreas, writtenRequest). Documents that name this check: document:referral-or-request-for-evaluation. REVIEW_REQUIRED. Not an executable predicate and not a compliance verdict.

definitions.label: Review heuristic only: a goal states a baseline, a target, a measurement method, a mastery criterion, and a date. The regulation requires measurable goals and a measurement description, not these five fields.
definitions.evidenceDescription: Recorded fields: entity:annual-goal (goalText, area, baselineValue, baselineUnit, baselineDate, targetValue, targetUnit, goalDate, measurementMethod, masteryCriterion, isFunctional). 34 CFR 300.320(d) limits added IEP-content demands. The five fields stay a review heuristic. REVIEW_REQUIRED. Not an executable predicate and not a compliance verdict.

authority.citation: HiveForYou IEP pack review practice (no external authority) — author-proposed review practice, not a legal requirement.

definitions.label: Benchmarks or short-term objectives for children taking alternate assessments on alternate achievement standards.
definitions.evidenceDescription: Recorded fields: entity:short-term-objective (objectiveText, targetDate). REVIEW_REQUIRED. Not an executable predicate and not a compliance verdict.

definitions.label: Parents may obtain an IEE, subject to (b)-(e). A parent who disagrees with an agency evaluation may request an IEE at public expense; the agency must, without unnecessary delay, file for due process or ensure the IEE is provided. One IEE at public expense per agency evaluation the parent disagrees with.
definitions.evidenceDescription: Recorded fields: entity:iee-request (requestDate, disagreedEvaluation, agencyResponseDate, agencyResponse). Documents that name this check: document:iee-request. REVIEW_REQUIRED. Not an executable predicate and not a compliance verdict.

definitions.label: Parent-obtained evaluations meeting agency criteria must be considered in FAPE decisions.
definitions.evidenceDescription: Recorded fields: entity:evaluation-report (discipline, reportDate, evaluatorRole, isIndependent, providedToParentDate); entity:evaluation-recommendation (recommendationText, recommendationType, domain, quantityAsWritten). Documents that name this check: document:private-evaluations, document:iee-report. REVIEW_REQUIRED. Not an executable predicate and not a compliance verdict.

definitions.label: Where service logs are kept, compare planned and delivered services. No federal rule requires service logs.
definitions.evidenceDescription: Recorded fields: entity:service-delivery-record (deliveryDate, minutesDelivered, missedReason). Documents that name this check: document:service-logs. Mapped by reusing AUTH-AP-SERVICE-LOGS, already recorded on document:service-logs. No legal citation was created. REVIEW_REQUIRED. Not an executable predicate and not a compliance verdict.

authority.citation: HiveForYou IEP pack review practice (no external authority) — author-proposed review practice, not a legal requirement.

definitions.label: A member may be excused when their area is discussed if parent and agency consent in writing and the member submits written input before the meeting.
definitions.evidenceDescription: Recorded fields: entity:meeting-participant (role, name, attended, excusedInWriting, writtenInputSubmitted). Documents that name this check: document:meeting-notice-attendance-page-any-excusal-forms. REVIEW_REQUIRED. Not an executable predicate and not a compliance verdict.

definitions.label: A meeting may proceed without parents if the agency cannot convince them to attend; attempts must be recorded (calls, correspondence, visits).
definitions.evidenceDescription: Recorded fields: entity:iep-meeting (meetingDate, purpose, parentAttended, attendanceMethod, interpreterProvided); entity:parent-communication (sentDate, sender, medium, subjectAsWritten). Documents that name this check: document:parent-communication. REVIEW_REQUIRED. Not an executable predicate and not a compliance verdict.

definitions.label: Agency ensures parents understand proceedings, including interpreters. Notice understandable to the public and in the parent's native language or mode of communication unless clearly not feasible.
definitions.evidenceDescription: Recorded fields: entity:parent-guardian (displayName, role, nativeLanguage, interpreterNeeded). REVIEW_REQUIRED. Not an executable predicate and not a compliance verdict.

definitions.label: Revise to address lack of expected progress, reevaluation results, parent information, anticipated needs, other matters.
definitions.evidenceDescription: Recorded fields: entity:progress-measurement (measurementDate, value, unit, measureName, statusDescriptor). Documents that name this check: document:progress-monitoring-data. REVIEW_REQUIRED. Not an executable predicate and not a compliance verdict.

definitions.label: For preschool children, how the disability affects participation in appropriate activities.
definitions.evidenceDescription: Recorded fields: entity:student (displayName, dateOfBirth, gradeAsWritten, primaryLanguage, englishLearnerStatus, homeLanguage). REVIEW_REQUIRED. Not an executable predicate and not a compliance verdict.

definitions.label: Comply with a parent's request to inspect records without unnecessary delay, before any IEP meeting or hearing, and in no case more than 45 days after the request. Right to copies where failure to provide them would effectively prevent inspection.
definitions.evidenceDescription: Recorded fields: entity:records-request (requestDate, responseDate, scopeAsWritten). Documents that name this check: document:records-request. REVIEW_REQUIRED. Not an executable predicate and not a compliance verdict.

definitions.label: Reevaluation is required if the agency determines needs warrant it, or a parent or teacher requests it. Reevaluation may not occur more than once a year unless parent and agency agree otherwise. Reevaluation must occur at least once every 3 years, unless parent and agency agree it is unnecessary.
definitions.evidenceDescription: Recorded fields: entity:referral (requestDate, requestedBy, requestType, suspectedAreas, writtenRequest); entity:evaluation (evaluationType, startDate, completionDate, reviewOfExistingDataDate, noAdditionalDataDecision, exceptionAsWritten). REVIEW_REQUIRED. Not an executable predicate and not a compliance verdict.

definitions.label: Informed consent is required before any reevaluation. Reevaluation consent is not needed if the agency made reasonable efforts and the parent failed to respond.
definitions.evidenceDescription: Recorded fields: entity:consent (activityType, decision, signedDate, receivedDate, scopeAsWritten). Documents that name this check: document:consent-to-reevaluate. REVIEW_REQUIRED. Not an executable predicate and not a compliance verdict.

definitions.label: As part of an initial evaluation (if appropriate) and any reevaluation, the team reviews existing data, including parent-provided evaluations and observations. On that review and parent input, identify additional data needed. Agency administers the assessments needed to produce the identified data. If no additional data are needed, parents are notified of that decision, the reasons, and their right to request an assessment.
definitions.evidenceDescription: Recorded fields: entity:evaluation (evaluationType, startDate, completionDate, reviewOfExistingDataDate, noAdditionalDataDecision, exceptionAsWritten). Documents that name this check: document:review-of-existing-data. REVIEW_REQUIRED. Not an executable predicate and not a compliance verdict.

definitions.label: At the beginning of each school year an IEP is in effect for each child with a disability. IEP reviewed periodically, not less than annually, to determine whether goals are being achieved.
definitions.evidenceDescription: Recorded fields: entity:iep (iepType, status, meetingDate, effectiveStartDate, effectiveEndDate, annualReviewDueDate, reevaluationDueDate, parentConcernsText, strengthsText). REVIEW_REQUIRED. Not an executable predicate and not a compliance verdict.

definitions.label: Notice describes the action, why, each evaluation/record relied on, safeguards statement, sources of help, options considered and rejected with reasons, and other relevant factors.
definitions.evidenceDescription: Recorded fields: entity:prior-written-notice (noticeDate, actionType, proposedOrRefused, actionDescription, reasons, recordsRelied, optionsRejected, safeguardsStatement). Documents that name this check: document:prior-written-notice-for-evaluation-eligibility-and-placement. REVIEW_REQUIRED. Not an executable predicate and not a compliance verdict.

definitions.label: In-State transfer: comparable services until the new agency adopts the prior IEP or develops a new one.
definitions.evidenceDescription: Recorded fields: entity:public-agency (name, state); entity:enrollment (startDate, endDate, grade, transferType, priorAgencyName, recordsRequestedDate). Documents that name this check: document:transfer-records, document:enrollment-record. REVIEW_REQUIRED. Not an executable predicate and not a compliance verdict.

definitions.label: Out-of-State transfer: comparable services until evaluation (if needed) and new IEP.
definitions.evidenceDescription: Recorded fields: entity:public-agency (name, state); entity:enrollment (startDate, endDate, grade, transferType, priorAgencyName, recordsRequestedDate). Documents that name this check: document:transfer-records. REVIEW_REQUIRED. Not an executable predicate and not a compliance verdict.

definitions.label: New agency promptly requests records; prior agency promptly responds.
definitions.evidenceDescription: Recorded fields: entity:enrollment (startDate, endDate, grade, transferType, priorAgencyName, recordsRequestedDate). Documents that name this check: document:transfer-records. REVIEW_REQUIRED. Not an executable predicate and not a compliance verdict.

definitions.label: From the first IEP in effect when the child turns 16 (younger if the team decides): measurable postsecondary goals and transition services.
definitions.evidenceDescription: Recorded fields: entity:transition-plan (postsecondaryEducationGoal, employmentGoal, independentLivingGoal, transitionAssessmentsAsWritten, transitionServicesText, courseOfStudy, studentInvited, agencyInvited). Documents that name this check: document:transition-assessment. REVIEW_REQUIRED. Not an executable predicate and not a compliance verdict.

definitions.label: From the first IEP in effect when the child turns 16 (younger if the team decides): measurable postsecondary goals and transition services. When postsecondary goals/transition are considered, invite the child, consider preferences if absent, and invite likely-responsible agencies with consent. For transition-age students, notice states transition purpose, student invitation, agencies invited.
definitions.evidenceDescription: Recorded fields: entity:meeting-notice (noticeDate, statedPurpose, statedTime, statedLocation, listedAttendees, mentionsTransition, mentionsInviteOthersRight); entity:transition-plan (postsecondaryEducationGoal, employmentGoal, independentLivingGoal, transitionAssessmentsAsWritten, transitionServicesText, courseOfStudy, studentInvited, agencyInvited). REVIEW_REQUIRED. Not an executable predicate and not a compliance verdict.

definitions.label: Starting at least one year before age of majority under State law, a statement that the child was informed of rights that transfer.
definitions.evidenceDescription: Recorded fields: entity:student (displayName, dateOfBirth, gradeAsWritten, primaryLanguage, englishLearnerStatus, homeLanguage); entity:age-of-majority-notice (statementText, informedDate). 34 CFR 300.520(a) is a partial snippet and is not the statement of this check. No state age is stored. REVIEW_REQUIRED. Not an executable predicate and not a compliance verdict.

definitions.label: SQ1
definitions.text: How will the time outside class be scheduled each week, and which lessons will my child miss?
definitions.conditionDescription: A service is delivered outside the general classroom

definitions.label: SQ2
definitions.text: How will what my child learns in those sessions carry over into the regular classroom?
definitions.conditionDescription: A service is delivered outside the general classroom

definitions.label: SQ3
definitions.text: Can I see the progress-monitoring numbers between report cards, for example once a month?
definitions.conditionDescription: Progress is reported quarterly or less often

definitions.label: SQ4
definitions.text: How will each accommodation be used in class and on tests, and who makes sure it happens?
definitions.conditionDescription: At least one accommodation is listed

definitions.label: SQ5
definitions.text: What can we do at home to support this goal without turning it into a struggle?
definitions.conditionDescription: At least one academic goal is listed

definitions.label: SQ6
definitions.text: Can someone walk me through each test result and what it means for teaching?
definitions.conditionDescription: The plan or the evaluations mention test results the parent may not have seen in full

definitions.label: SQ7
definitions.text: If the numbers are not moving after six to eight weeks, what will the team change, and who decides?
definitions.conditionDescription: At least one goal is measured by repeated probes or progress monitoring

definitions.label: SQ8
definitions.text: How will my child get the content in reading-heavy subjects while reading is still slow?
definitions.conditionDescription: A reading need is documented and the child takes subjects with a lot of reading (such as science or social studies)

definitions.label: Q1
definitions.text: Which state is the school in?
definitions.rationale: Timelines and what a signature means differ by state

definitions.label: Q2
definitions.text: Have you signed the IEP or a consent for services? When?
definitions.rationale: Decides whether the report is "before you sign" or "what you can still ask"

definitions.label: Q3
definitions.text: Is there a meeting date or a date you must reply by?
definitions.rationale: Orders the questions and document requests by urgency

definitions.label: Q4
definitions.text: What are your two biggest worries, in your own words?

definitions.label: Q5
definitions.text: What do you see at home (reading, homework, behaviour)?
definitions.rationale: Compared with present levels; shown as "you told us"

definitions.label: Q6
definitions.text: Any private evaluations or diagnoses not uploaded?

definitions.label: Q7
definitions.text: Your role and what you need to produce (meeting prep, letter, case assessment)
definitions.rationale: Sets depth and the closing section

definitions.label: L1
definitions.text: What did the school decide about my child, and why?
definitions.rationale: Explain the written eligibility decision, the category, and the documented needs in everyday words, including the evaluation findings and what these documents do not establish. No legal conclusion. Objectives: objective:customer:eligibility-and-needs, objective:customer:explain-findings, objective:customer:not-established.

definitions.label: L2
definitions.text: What help will my child get: how much, how often, where, from when?
definitions.rationale: State each service as frequency, minutes, location, and start, and each accommodation as the classroom support the IEP says it gives. For each goal, state the written baseline, target, mastery criterion, measurement method, and date. Objectives: objective:customer:services, objective:customer:accommodations, objective:customer:goal-measurement.

definitions.label: L3
definitions.text: Does that match what the testing found, and is the goal big enough to catch up?
definitions.rationale: For each identified need, say whether an annual goal covers it and whether the goal numbers match the evaluation. Say whether a previous IEP is in the file. If it is not, say these documents do not show an earlier plan. Do not judge the goal ambitious or adequate. Objectives: objective:customer:need-has-goal, objective:customer:goal-measurement, objective:customer:prior-iep-changes.

definitions.label: L4
definitions.text: What should I ask or ask for before I sign?
definitions.rationale: Give at most seven questions for the next meeting and the specific records to request. Each request names what the file does not show. Do not advise a signature. Objective: objective:customer:meeting-questions-and-records.

definitions.label: L5
definitions.text: What does signing commit me to, and what happens next?
definitions.rationale: Distinguish consent to evaluate from consent for initial services, and state the written progress-reporting schedule and whether actual progress reports are in the file. Do not advise whether to sign. What an IEP signature means depends on the state and the form. Objectives: objective:customer:participation-and-consent, objective:customer:progress-evidence.

definitions.label: The child's parent or guardian
definitions.context: A parent or guardian reviewing this child's IEP documents before a meeting. The work is to understand the eligibility decision and documented needs, the evaluation findings, whether each need has a goal, how each goal is measured, what services and accommodations are written, how progress will be reported and what progress evidence is actually in the file, what changed if an earlier IEP exists, and how participation, concerns, and consent are recorded. The result is an explanation and a short list of questions and records for the next meeting.

objectives.description: Understand the educational eligibility decision and the documented needs.
objectives.conditionDescription: The preserved looking-for question stays REVIEW_REQUIRED. This predicate is the planner input and is not written onto the question.

expected.statement: State the written decision, category, and needs. A blank parent-input section is not shown. Do not say the decision was correct.

objectives.limits: No legal conclusion. A missing record means these documents do not show it.

objectives.description: Explain the evaluation findings in parent-friendly words.
objectives.conditionDescription: The preserved looking-for question stays REVIEW_REQUIRED. This predicate is the planner input and is not written onto the question.

expected.statement: Restate the written scores and what they measure. calculation:C6 is declaration-only, so a numeric mismatch stays a review unless both figures are cited. Do not treat a speech-language finding of no separate need as a finding of no reading need.

objectives.limits: No legal conclusion. Terms explain the written numbers. They are not evidence about this child beyond the cited scores.

objectives.description: Whether each identified need has a corresponding annual goal.
objectives.conditionDescription: The preserved looking-for question stays REVIEW_REQUIRED. This predicate is the planner input and is not written onto the question.

expected.statement: Pair each written need with a goal, or say the goal is not shown. A finding of no separate need does not require a goal.

objectives.limits: No legal conclusion. A missing record means these documents do not show it.

objectives.description: Baseline, target, mastery criterion, measurement method, and date for each goal.
objectives.conditionDescription: The preserved looking-for question stays REVIEW_REQUIRED. This predicate is the planner input and is not written onto the question.

expected.statement: Report the written baseline, target, mastery, method, and date. check:G2 is field presence. check:G3 and the norm gaps stay reviews. calculation:C8 and calculation:C9 are declaration-only. Do not tell the parent the target is or is not enough.

objectives.limits: No legal conclusion. A missing record means these documents do not show it.

objectives.description: Frequency, minutes, location, and start of special education services.
objectives.conditionDescription: The preserved looking-for question stays REVIEW_REQUIRED. This predicate is the planner input and is not written onto the question.

expected.statement: State frequency, minutes, location, and start as written. calculation:C3 and calculation:C5 run only from those cited fields. A missing grid cell is not shown.

objectives.limits: No legal conclusion. A missing record means these documents do not show it.

definitions.label: L1
definitions.text: Is the record complete and current: what is missing, who holds it, and is this the plan in effect?

definitions.label: L2
definitions.text: Were the procedural steps and timelines met?
definitions.rationale: Review referral, evaluation consent, evaluation completion, eligibility date, meeting notice, participation, prior written notice, separate consent for initial services, service start, and annual-review currentness. Use chain:CH4 and the day-count calculations. A state evaluation timeline stays unverified without a state overlay. Objective: objective:professional:procedural-review.

definitions.label: L3
definitions.text: Is eligibility supported, and were other causes ruled out on the record?
definitions.rationale: Compare referral concerns with assessed areas and with the educational and functional findings. When the category is a specific learning disability, review the SLD documentation and exclusionary factors. Compare evaluation figures with present levels. A missing exclusionary form is not a finding that the factors were ruled out. Objective: objective:professional:evaluation-eligibility-review.

definitions.label: L4
definitions.text: Does each need trace to a present level, a goal, a service and a progress measure, and where does the chain break?
definitions.rationale: Trace each identified need to present levels, an annual goal, a service, and a progress measure. Mark missing links, conflicts, and reviews that stay a professional judgment. Objectives: objective:professional:goals-services-review, objective:professional:progress-implementation.

definitions.label: L5
definitions.text: Are the goals measurable and ambitious, and do services cover what the evaluations recommended?
definitions.rationale: Review the written baseline, target, method, mastery criterion, and date, and the planned minutes, location, and frequency. Compare evaluation recommendations with IEP provisions. check:G2a and goal ambition stay review judgments, not federal verdicts. Open behavior, assistive technology, extended school year, reevaluation, transfer, and transition only when the file raises them. Objectives: objective:professional:goals-services-review, objective:professional:individualized-factors.

definitions.label: L6
definitions.text: Where do the documents conflict or leave fields blank?
definitions.rationale: List conflicts between the evaluation and the IEP, blank fields, and progress or service figures that the file does not contain. Objective: objective:professional:evaluation-eligibility-review. Progress comparisons: objective:professional:progress-implementation.

definitions.label: L7
definitions.text: What should be raised at the meeting and requested in writing, in what order, and what in the record supports each point?
definitions.rationale: Order the issues to investigate, the records to request, the meeting agenda, and the written-request language. Every point cites a finding in the file. No outcome prediction and no legal conclusion. Objectives: objective:professional:work-priorities, objective:professional:work-record-requests, objective:professional:work-agenda, objective:professional:work-follow-up, objective:professional:work-limitations.

definitions.label: Present levels
definitions.meaning: Where the child is now; the starting line for each goal

definitions.label: Accommodation
definitions.meaning: The same work with support. A modification changes what is expected

definitions.label: Pull-out
definitions.meaning: Teaching outside the general classroom. Push-in is support inside it

definitions.label: Related services
definitions.meaning: Speech, occupational therapy, counselling and similar supports

definitions.label: Prior written notice
definitions.meaning: The district's written explanation of a decision, including what it refused

definitions.label: Least restrictive environment
definitions.meaning: Learning alongside classmates without disabilities as much as is appropriate

definitions.label: Extended school year
definitions.meaning: Services during school breaks when needed to keep skills

definitions.label: Standard score
definitions.meaning: A test score where 100 is average; most children score between 85 and 115

definitions.label: Percentile
definitions.meaning: The share of same-age children who scored the same or lower. It is not percent correct

definitions.label: N1
definitions.text: Agreeing to testing is not agreeing to services. The school needs a separate consent before it starts special education for the first time.

definitions.label: N2
definitions.text: What a signature on the IEP form itself means (attendance only, or agreement) depends on the state and the form. Ask before you sign.

definitions.label: N3
definitions.text: You are entitled to a copy of the IEP and of the evaluation reports at no cost.

definitions.label: N4
definitions.text: The reading numbers are compared with a national table of typical readers. A score 10 or more words below the middle of the table usually means a child needs extra fluency support. A goal that only matches typical growth keeps the gap the same size; closing it needs faster growth. If the school's own test has its own norms, those are the better comparison.

definitions.label: N6
definitions.text: You can share what you see at home: what your child enjoys, when they feel confident, and when schoolwork is tiring or stressful. The team is required to consider a parent's concerns when it writes the IEP.

definitions.label: N5
definitions.text: Grade or age equivalents are rough and should not be read as "reads like a first grader".

definitions.label: {first name}'s first IEP: what it says and what to ask

sections.heading: The short answer
sections.templateDescription: narrative: if check T0 is not SHOWN, say first, in one sentence, that this plan's dates have passed and the parent may need the newer one; then answer question:customer:L1 to question:customer:L3 in order, one or two sentences each, including what these documents do not establish; then the person's worries (question:Q4) if given; do not advise a signature; block unanswered

sections.heading: What the school decided
sections.templateDescription: narrative: the written eligibility decision, category, and documented needs (question:customer:L1, check:E2, check:P1, chain:CH1). Explain the evaluation findings in everyday words from the written scores (check:E1, check:P2). A blank parent-concerns section is something these documents do not show (check:P3). No regulation citations and no statement that the decision was right or wrong.

sections.heading: What {first name} will get
sections.templateDescription: narrative + block spine_table: each goal as baseline, target, mastery criterion, measurement method, and date (check:G2); each service as frequency, minutes, location, and start (check:S1, check:S2, check:T8); each accommodation and the classroom participation it is written to support (check:A1, question:SQ4 when an accommodation is listed); block computed (C4, C8, C9) when those calculations have cited inputs (question:customer:L2). C8 and C9 are declaration-only. Do not call the target adequate.

sections.heading: Does the plan match the testing?
sections.templateDescription: block chains, as two lists: Matches, Worth asking (question:customer:L3). Say whether each identified need has an annual goal (check:G1, chain:CH2). If document:prior-iep or document:iep-amendment is in the file, say what changed (chain:CH6). If neither is in the file, say these documents do not show an earlier IEP. Do not open chain:CH6 only because it exists in the pack.

sections.heading: Questions to ask before you sign
sections.templateDescription: block questions: check questions and standing questions together, at most seven, most important first (question:customer:L4); block general_notes (note:N6). Questions for the next meeting. Do not advise a signature.

sections.heading: What to ask the school for
sections.templateDescription: block gaps (document requests by holder, ask now before later) (question:customer:L4). Each request names the check it would settle and the reason it matters for the meeting.

sections.heading: What signing means
sections.templateDescription: block general_notes (note:N1, note:N2, note:N3) (question:customer:L5). Distinguish consent to evaluate (check:T1) from separate consent for initial services (check:T7, note:N1). State that what a signature on the IEP form means depends on the state and the form (note:N2, question:Q1). Do not recommend signing or refusing.

sections.heading: What happens next
sections.templateDescription: block computed (C7a) + narrative: the written progress-reporting frequency (check:G4) and the dates (question:customer:L5). If progress reports or probe data are in the file, describe those written results (chain:CH5). If they are not, say these documents do not show actual progress.

sections.heading: Words used in these documents
sections.templateDescription: block terms. Use the terms that explain scores the parent will see, including words-correct-per-minute, present levels, accommodation, and the difference between a score and a percent. note:N5 when a grade or age equivalent appears.

definitions.voice: about an 8th-grade reading level; the child's first name; address the parent as "you"; numbers exactly as written with units; explain scores in everyday words; "Your documents show", "These documents don't show", "Worth asking"; no check ids, no regulation citations, no verdict labels. Do not advise the parent to sign or not to sign.

definitions.label: Initial IEP file review: {student}

sections.heading: Bottom line
sections.templateDescription: narrative: if check T0 is not SHOWN, state that first with the dates; then answer question:professional:L1 to question:professional:L7 in order, one sentence each; block unanswered. No legal conclusion.

sections.heading: Points to raise
sections.templateDescription: narrative: prioritized issues to investigate further, most important first, drawn from checks that are not SHOWN, chain rows with a missing link, and conflicts. Each point states the cited finding, what is missing or in conflict, and the specific document or written request to make. Every sentence cites the facts of its finding. No predictions of outcome and no legal conclusions (question:professional:L7).

sections.heading: Snapshot
sections.templateDescription: narrative: student, grade, school, category, key dates, state, the request; block documents

sections.heading: Chronology
sections.templateDescription: Chronological case reconstruction. block timeline + block computed (C1, C2, C3, C7a, C7b, C10, C15, C16, C21); chain:CH4; checks T0 through T9, including check:T0a and check:T5a. Flag "state timeline not verified" when no overlay (question:professional:L2). C10 and C16 are declaration-only. Day counts are arithmetic from cited dates, not a finding that a deadline was met.

sections.heading: Checklist
sections.templateDescription: block checklist: id, check, verdict, evidence, authority; rows that are not SHOWN first (question:professional:L2, question:professional:L3). Verdicts stay SHOWN, PARTLY SHOWN, NOT SHOWN, CONFLICT, and NOT APPLICABLE. A REVIEW_REQUIRED criterion stays a review, not a compliance verdict. Mark verified rows only when the cited facts show the criterion. Mark conflicting rows from the conflict block. Mark not-shown rows as absent from these documents.

sections.heading: Alignment
sections.templateDescription: Evaluation-to-IEP matrix and the need-to-goal-to-service-to-progress trace. block chains (chain:CH1, chain:CH2, chain:CH3) with missing links marked (question:professional:L4). Use chain:CH4 for the procedural reconstruction, chain:CH5 when progress measurements are in the file, chain:CH6 only when a prior IEP or amendment is in the file, and chain:CH7 for parent participation. Do not mark a chain row present only because the chain exists in the pack.

sections.heading: Goal analysis
sections.templateDescription: block spine_table (goals) + block computed (C4, C8, C9) (question:professional:L5). For each goal, the written baseline, target, measurement method, mastery criterion, and date (check:G2). check:G2a is a review heuristic, not a federal requirement of five fields. check:G3 stays REVIEW_REQUIRED. C8 and C9 are declaration-only.

sections.heading: Services against recommendations
sections.templateDescription: block spine_table (services) + block computed (C5) + narrative on check:S3 and check:S4 (question:professional:L5). Planned instruction, minutes, location, and frequency (check:S1, check:S2). Evaluation recommendations against IEP provisions (chain:CH3). A recommendation that is not in the IEP is a missing link or a review, not a refusal, unless prior written notice records the refusal.

sections.heading: Conflicts and inconsistencies
sections.templateDescription: block conflicts + block computed (C6) (question:professional:L6). C6 is declaration-only. Compare evaluation figures with IEP present levels (check:P2). A baseline and a target for the same measure are different quantities, not a conflict.

sections.heading: Document requests
sections.templateDescription: block gaps with the check each one settles and the reason that check is still open (question:professional:L1). Do not request a record the file already contains.

sections.heading: Meeting agenda
sections.templateDescription: Evidence-backed meeting agenda. block questions (all, check and standing) + narrative: points for a parent-concerns letter and the written-request sentences, each tied to a cited finding (question:professional:L7).

sections.heading: Coverage and caveats
sections.templateDescription: narrative: unreadable pages, checks not applicable, state rules not verified, and conditional checks that were not opened because the file did not raise them (specific learning disability exclusions only when that category is written; behavior, assistive technology, and extended school year only when that factor or document is in the file; reevaluation, transfer, and transition only when that event or age is in the file). Separate federal citations, state-dependent questions, professional heuristics, and verified source facts. Name matters left for professional judgment. Pack version and verification date.

definitions.voice: dense; typed values as written; original quotes on expand; points to raise are asks grounded in the record, never predictions or legal conclusions; "see 34 CFR ..." rather than a conclusion. Checklist verdicts stay the existing labels. A federal citation, a state rule, a professional heuristic, and a fact in the file stay distinct. Conditional checks stay inactive unless the file raises them.

definitions.label: Evidence and question columns
definitions.text: Evidence = what must be cited for SHOWN. Question = customer wording when the verdict is not SHOWN; "-" means no question.

definitions.label: Standing questions when checks are shown
definitions.text: Worth asking whenever the condition holds, even if every check is SHOWN. The study marks which apply, citing the facts that make the condition true; code shows the question text as written. They join the check questions in one priority order.

definitions.label: Chain rows
definitions.text: Build one row per starting item; a missing link is a finding. CH1 Concern to testing: Referral concern; Area assessed; Result. CH2 Need to progress: Need in evaluation; Present-level statement; Annual goal; Service (minutes, setting); Progress measure and reporting date. CH3 Recommendation to plan: Evaluation recommendation; IEP service, accommodation or goal; Recorded reason if not adopted.

definitions.label: Cited arithmetic
definitions.text: Code does the arithmetic from cited values. Ops: DAYS_BETWEEN(start, end), DIFFERENCE(a, b), RATE_PER_WEEK(from, to, start, end), SUM_BY(value, group), ADD_INTERVAL(date, interval), REFERENCE_GAP(value, table, row, column). Authority for C7a: 300.324(b)(1)(i). For C7b: 300.303(b)(2), unless parent and school agree a re-evaluation is unnecessary.

definitions.label: Oral reading fluency passage
definitions.text: Hasbrouck & Tindal (2017). Words correct per minute on unpracticed grade-level passages.

definitions.label: General notes are not proof
definitions.text: Shown as written under "In general"; never proof about this child.

definitions.label: v7 document request schedule
definitions.text: Documents usually needed, as stated for an initial review. Prior written notice for evaluation, eligibility and placement — holder THIRD_PARTY (district); when before signing; settles T5, S3. Procedural safeguards notice — holder THIRD_PARTY (district); when before signing; settles T6. Signed consent to evaluate — holder ASKER_OR_CLIENT or THIRD_PARTY (district); when before signing; settles T1, T2. Consent for services — holder THIRD_PARTY (district); when before signing; settles T7. Referral or request for evaluation — holder ASKER_OR_CLIENT or THIRD_PARTY (school); when before signing; settles E1. Exclusionary-factors review (learning disability) — holder THIRD_PARTY (school); when before signing; settles E3, E4. Classroom observation — holder THIRD_PARTY (school); when before signing; settles E6. Intervention / response-to-intervention data — holder THIRD_PARTY (teacher); when before signing; settles E5, E9. Parent input record — holder THIRD_PARTY (school); when before signing; settles P3, E1. Meeting notice, attendance page, any excusal forms — holder THIRD_PARTY (school); when before signing; settles T4, M1. Report cards, state test results, attendance — holder ASKER_OR_CLIENT; when if available; settles P1, E3. Private evaluations — holder ASKER_OR_CLIENT; when if any; applies when has had a private evaluation; settles E1, S3. Progress reports — holder THIRD_PARTY (school); when each reporting period (later); settles G4. Service logs — holder THIRD_PARTY (school); when if progress is slow (later); settles S1.

definitions.label: v7 jurisdiction and verification limits
definitions.text: Jurisdiction: US federal (IDEA Part B, 34 CFR Part 300); state overlay in references/<state>.md when present. Verified: 2026-11-11 - every Authority cell checked against the regulation text (eCFR / CFR, 34 CFR Part 300); reading norms checked against Hasbrouck & Tindal (2017). Exception - 300.106 confirmed by section title only. Status: federal checklist verified against primary sources; state rules not included (a state may set a different evaluation timeline and extra requirements); informational, not legal advice.

definitions.label: v7 sources
definitions.text: 34 CFR Part 300, Subparts B, D and E (eCFR): 300.11, 300.106, 300.114, 300.300-300.311, 300.320-300.324, 300.503, 300.504. Hasbrouck, J. & Tindal, G. (2017). An update to compiled ORF norms (Technical Report No. 1702). University of Oregon. Endrew F. v. Douglas County School District RE-1, 580 U.S. 386 (2017).

definitions.label: Customer report does not advise a signature
definitions.text: The customer report explains the written consent documents and that what a signature on the IEP form means depends on the state and the form. It does not advise the parent to sign or to withhold a signature. note:N1 and note:N2 stay available. This guideline makes no legal conclusion.

definitions.label: Open a conditional check only when the file raises it
definitions.text: Presence of a check in this pack is not a reason to investigate it. Specific learning disability exclusion, observation, and intervention checks apply when the written category is a specific learning disability. Behavior supports, assistive technology, and extended school year apply when that factor or its document is in the file. Reevaluation, transfer, and transition apply only when the file shows that event or that the IEP will be in effect at the transition age. A state evaluation timeline stays unverified unless a state overlay is present. check:G2a is a professional review heuristic. check:G3 stays a review and is not an executable finding that a goal is adequate. No report states a violation.
